why: Both analyses diagnose the doom loop, the obsolete small stores, the price war and the dividend starvation almost identically, but Analysis 1 puts modern large stores at the centre of its hedgehog, whereas Analysis 2 anchors on store brands and rules out the larger-store format. Analysis 1 is also better calibrated on the foundation's unknown current stake and its decline register is closer to the later liquidation, while Analysis 2 has the tighter one-screen verdict.
